# Population Offset E_g (Year-Specific)

Extracts year-specific population from WorldPop 100 m rasters per Section 3.3:
$E_{g,t} = \text{pop}_g(\text{year})$, floored at 0.1 to prevent $\log(0)$.

Output: `population_{state}_{year}.csv` with columns `grid_id`, `population`, `E`, `log_E`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("helpers/_utils.R"))
load_pipeline()

library(data.table); library(sf); library(terra); library(exactextractr)
library(ggplot2);    library(viridis); library(patchwork); library(ggspatial)

study_years <- unique(as.character(WAVE_RUNS$acs_year))
PLOT_PIX_M  <- 400  # pixel size (m) for NY plot rasterization (visual only)
```

# Extract Population

```{r extract}
fmt_dur <- function(s) {
  s <- as.numeric(s)
  if (s < 60) sprintf("%.1fs", s)
  else if (s < 3600) sprintf("%dm %02ds", s %/% 60, round(s %% 60))
  else sprintf("%dh %02dm", s %/% 3600, (s %% 3600) %/% 60)
}

extract_pop <- function(grid_sf, year, label = "") {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  message(sprintf("  [%s] %s: loading raster ...", format(t0, "%H:%M:%S"), label))
  r <- terra::rast(file.path(CONFIG$pop_raster_dir,
         sprintf("usa_pop_%s_CN_100m_R2025A_v1.tif", year)))

  message(sprintf("  [%s] %s: reprojecting %s cells to raster CRS ...",
                  format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), label,
                  format(nrow(grid_sf), big.mark = ",")))
  grid_in_r <- st_transform(grid_sf, terra::crs(r))

  message(sprintf("  [%s] %s: extracting (exact_extract, sum) ...",
                  format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), label))
  v <- exactextractr::exact_extract(r, grid_in_r, "sum", progress = TRUE)
  v[is.na(v)] <- 0
  pop <- round(v, 2)

  dt <- data.table(grid_id = grid_sf$grid_id, population = pop,
                   E = pmax(pop, 0.1), log_E = log(pmax(pop, 0.1)))
  message(sprintf("  [%s] %s: done in %s (total pop = %s)",
                  format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), label,
                  fmt_dur(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")),
                  format(round(sum(pop)), big.mark = ",")))
  dt
}

total_jobs <- length(CONFIG$states) * length(study_years)
job_i <- 0L
t_all <- Sys.time()

for (state in CONFIG$states) {
  message("\n=== ", state, " ===")
  grid_sf <- st_read(file.path(CONFIG$grids_dir, sprintf("grid_100m_%s.gpkg", state)),
                     quiet = TRUE)
  for (year in study_years) {
    job_i <- job_i + 1L
    label <- sprintf("[%d/%d] %s %s", job_i, total_jobs, state, year)
    out   <- file.path(CONFIG$grids_dir, sprintf("population_%s_%s.csv", state, year))
    fwrite(extract_pop(grid_sf, year, label), out)
    message("  wrote ", out)
  }
}

message(sprintf("\nAll %d files written in %s.",
                total_jobs, fmt_dur(difftime(Sys.time(), t_all, units = "secs"))))
```

# Visualization

```{r viz, fig.width=14, fig.height=5, dev='png', dpi=120}
plot_ut <- function(grid_sf, pop_dt, year) {
  g <- merge(grid_sf, pop_dt[, .(grid_id, population)], by = "grid_id", all.x = TRUE)
  g$log_pop <- log10(pmax(g$population, 1))
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = g, aes(fill = log_pop), color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_viridis(option = "plasma", name = expression(log[10](E))) +
    geom_sf_label(data = g[g$population > 50000, ],
                  aes(label = paste0(county_name, "\n", scales::comma(population))),
                  size = 2, fill = alpha("white", 0.7)) +
    map_extras() + labs(title = sprintf("UT %s", year)) + theme_map()
}

plot_ny <- function(grid_sf, base_outline, cent_xy, bb, utm_crs, pop_dt, year) {
  log_pop <- log10(pmax(pop_dt$population[match(grid_sf$grid_id, pop_dt$grid_id)], 1))
  ix <- floor((cent_xy[, 1] - bb["xmin"]) / PLOT_PIX_M)
  iy <- floor((cent_xy[, 2] - bb["ymin"]) / PLOT_PIX_M)
  px <- data.table(ix = ix, iy = iy, lp = log_pop)[
          , .(log_pop = mean(lp, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(ix, iy)]
  px[, x := bb["xmin"] + (ix + 0.5) * PLOT_PIX_M]
  px[, y := bb["ymin"] + (iy + 0.5) * PLOT_PIX_M]
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = base_outline, fill = "grey95", color = "grey70",
            linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_raster(data = px, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = log_pop)) +
    coord_sf(crs = utm_crs) +
    scale_fill_viridis(option = "plasma", name = expression(log[10](E))) +
    map_extras() + labs(title = sprintf("NY %s", year)) + theme_map()
}

for (state in CONFIG$states) {
  grid_sf <- st_read(file.path(CONFIG$grids_dir, sprintf("grid_100m_%s.gpkg", state)),
                     quiet = TRUE)
  utm_crs <- st_crs(grid_sf)
  read_pop <- function(y) fread(file.path(CONFIG$grids_dir,
                                          sprintf("population_%s_%s.csv", state, y)))

  if (state == "UT") {
    plots <- lapply(study_years, function(y) plot_ut(grid_sf, read_pop(y), y))
  } else {
    cbg <- st_transform(st_read(get_cbg_path(state), quiet = TRUE), utm_crs)
    cbg <- cbg[substr(cbg$GEOID, 3, 5) %in% get_metro_fips(state, 3), ]
    base_outline <- sf::st_union(cbg)
    cent_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_centroid(grid_sf))
    bb      <- sf::st_bbox(grid_sf)
    plots <- lapply(study_years, function(y)
      plot_ny(grid_sf, base_outline, cent_xy, bb, utm_crs, read_pop(y), y))
  }
  print(wrap_plots(plots, ncol = length(study_years)))
}
```
